description: Tier-1 native clustered (paper Section 6.3.1): facilities Uniform[0,10]^2; each customer drawn from truncated bivariate normal around an assigned facility, std=2, truncated to [0,10]^2; 135 customers split across 14 facilities -> 9 facilities get 10 customers and 5 get 9 customers (135 = 14*9 + 9). Scale: m=14, n=135, T=6 ([STRICT] real-world cap x 1.5 by explicit user override).
